title: 琵琶行
author: 白居易
intro: On an autumn night by the river, an exiled official hears a stranger play the pipa — and her music and her life story turn out to mirror his own. One of the most famous long poems in Chinese, and perhaps the best description of music ever written in the language.
analysis: 这首长诗讲了一个故事。诗人被贬到江州，一个秋夜在江边送客，忽然听到船上有人弹琵琶。弹琵琶的是一位从长安来的女子：年轻时名满京城，老了以后嫁给商人，一个人守着空船。全诗分四段：相遇、弹奏、女子自述身世、诗人自叹。最有名的是第二段写音乐：用急雨、私语、珠子落进玉盘、黄莺叫、泉水在冰下流、银瓶破裂、铁骑冲出来等一连串比喻，把听不见的声音变成看得见、摸得着的画面。“此时无声胜有声”一句，写出音乐停顿时比有声更动人。女子和诗人一个失去青春，一个失去官位，所以诗人说“同是天涯沦落人，相逢何必曾相识”——这两句今天还常被引用。结尾诗人听得泪湿青衫，把同情和自伤合在一起。
analysisEn:
The poem tells a story. Bai Juyi has been demoted to a small post in Jiangzhou. One autumn night, seeing a friend off at the river, he hears someone playing the pipa (a plucked lute) on a nearby boat. The player is a woman from the capital, Chang’an: once a celebrated musician, now past her youth and married to a tea merchant who leaves her alone on the boat for months.

The poem moves in four parts: the meeting, the music, her life story, and the poet’s own story. The second part is the famous one. Bai turns sound into pictures with a chain of comparisons — sudden rain, whispering, pearls big and small falling on a jade plate, an oriole’s song, a spring choking under ice, a silver jar bursting, armoured horsemen charging out. When the music pauses, he writes 此时无声胜有声: “at this moment, silence says more than sound.”

The woman has lost her youth; the poet has lost his career. That is why he says 同是天涯沦落人，相逢何必曾相识 — “we are both cast out to the ends of the earth; why must we have known each other before to understand each other?” Chinese people still quote these lines about strangers who share a hard fate. In the end, the person crying hardest in the room is the poet himself, his blue official’s robe wet with tears.
background: Bai Juyi (772–846) was one of the most popular Tang poets, known for writing in plain language that ordinary people could follow. In 815 he was demoted to assistant prefect (司马) of Jiangzhou, today’s Jiujiang in Jiangxi, after speaking out too boldly at court; he wrote this poem there in the autumn of 816.
pronunciation: 浔阳 xún；荻 dí；瑟瑟 sè sè；惨将别 jiāng；回灯 huí、重开宴 chóng；轻拢慢捻抹复挑 niǎn、mò、tiāo；六幺 liù yāo；嘈嘈 cáo；间关 jiān guān；幽咽 yōu yè；冰下难 nán（难以流通，不读 nàn）；迸 bèng；曲终收拨当心画 huà；舫 fǎng；敛容 liǎn；虾蟆陵 há má líng；名属 shǔ；教坊 jiào fāng；曾教善才服 jiāo（使、让）；五陵年少 shào；缠头 chán tóu；红绡 xiāo；钿头银篦 diàn、bì；暮去朝来 zhāo；重利 zhòng；少年事 shào；阑干 lán gān；重唧唧 chóng；谪居 zhé；湓江 pén；呕哑嘲哳 ōu yā zhāo zhā；难为听 wéi；仙乐 yuè；更坐 gèng；为君 wèi；却坐 què；衣裳 yī cháng。铁骑：古读 jì，网站采用 jì；《普通话异读词审音表》（2016 修订稿）统读 qí。声声思：作名词“悲伤的情思”，传统读 sì，今多读 sī，网站采用 sī。还独倾：古读 huán（又、仍），今多读 hái，网站采用 huán。
version: 采用统编高中语文教材（选择性必修中册）的正文，诗前的序不收。原诗又题《琵琶引》，全诗 88 句、616 字，这里一句一联共 44 行，分段照教材的四段。重要异文：“枫叶荻花秋瑟瑟”一作“秋索索”；“似诉平生不得志”一作“不得意”；“初为霓裳后六幺”一作“后绿腰”（同一支曲子的两种写法）；“小弦切切”一作“窃窃”；“幽咽泉流冰下难”一作“水下滩”，清代段玉裁考证当作“冰下难”，教材从之；“冰泉冷涩”一作“水泉”；“钿头银篦”一作“云篦”；“相逢何必曾相识”一作“相悲”；“曲罢曾教善才服”一作“常教”“伏”。

lines.zh: 浔阳江头夜送客，枫叶荻花秋瑟瑟。
lines.rhythm: 浔阳/江头/夜送客，枫叶/荻花/秋瑟瑟
lines.py: xún yáng jiāng tóu yè sòng kè, fēng yè dí huā qiū sè sè
lines.lit: At the head of the Xunyang River, at night, seeing off a guest; maple leaves, reed flowers, autumn rustling.
lines.en: By the Xunyang River one night I saw a friend off; maple leaves and reed plumes shivered in the autumn wind.

lines.zh: 主人下马客在船，举酒欲饮无管弦。
lines.rhythm: 主人/下马/客在船，举酒/欲饮/无管弦
lines.py: zhǔ rén xià mǎ kè zài chuán, jǔ jiǔ yù yǐn wú guǎn xián
lines.lit: The host gets off his horse, the guest is in the boat; raising wine, about to drink — no pipes or strings.
lines.en: I left my horse, my friend went aboard; we raised our cups, but there was no music.

lines.zh: 醉不成欢惨将别，别时茫茫江浸月。
lines.rhythm: 醉不成欢/惨将别，别时/茫茫/江浸月
lines.py: zuì bù chéng huān cǎn jiāng bié, bié shí máng máng jiāng jìn yuè
lines.lit: Drunk but not happy, sadly about to part; at parting, vast and blurred, the river soaks the moon.
lines.en: The wine brought no joy, only the sadness of parting; the wide dim river held the drowned moon.

lines.zh: 忽闻水上琵琶声，主人忘归客不发。
lines.rhythm: 忽闻/水上/琵琶声，主人/忘归/客不发
lines.py: hū wén shuǐ shàng pí pá shēng, zhǔ rén wàng guī kè bù fā
lines.lit: Suddenly hearing a pipa’s sound on the water; the host forgets to go home, the guest does not set off.
lines.en: Then, across the water, the sound of a pipa — I forgot to go home, and my friend forgot to sail.

lines.zh: 寻声暗问弹者谁，琵琶声停欲语迟。
lines.rhythm: 寻声/暗问/弹者谁，琵琶/声停/欲语迟
lines.py: xún shēng àn wèn tán zhě shuí, pí pá shēng tíng yù yǔ chí
lines.lit: Following the sound, quietly asking who the player is; the pipa stops, about to speak, but slow.
lines.en: We followed the sound and asked softly who was playing; the music stopped, and the answer was slow to come.

lines.zh: 移船相近邀相见，添酒回灯重开宴。
lines.rhythm: 移船/相近/邀相见，添酒/回灯/重开宴
lines.py: yí chuán xiāng jìn yāo xiāng jiàn, tiān jiǔ huí dēng chóng kāi yàn
lines.lit: Moving the boat close, inviting her to meet; adding wine, bringing back the lamps, starting the feast again.
lines.en: We drew our boat alongside and asked to meet her, poured more wine, relit the lamps, and began the feast again.

lines.zh: 千呼万唤始出来，犹抱琵琶半遮面。
lines.rhythm: 千呼/万唤/始出来，犹抱/琵琶/半遮面
lines.py: qiān hū wàn huàn shǐ chū lái, yóu bào pí pá bàn zhē miàn
lines.lit: A thousand calls, ten thousand summons, only then she comes out; still holding the pipa, half hiding her face.
lines.en: Only after we called and called did she come out, still holding the pipa up to hide half her face.

lines.zh: 转轴拨弦三两声，未成曲调先有情。
lines.rhythm: 转轴/拨弦/三两声，未成/曲调/先有情
lines.py: zhuàn zhóu bō xián sān liǎng shēng, wèi chéng qǔ diào xiān yǒu qíng
lines.lit: Turning the pegs, plucking the strings, two or three sounds; before it becomes a tune, there is already feeling.
lines.en: She turned the pegs and tried the strings — two or three notes, not yet a tune, but already full of feeling.

lines.zh: 弦弦掩抑声声思，似诉平生不得志。
lines.rhythm: 弦弦/掩抑/声声思，似诉/平生/不得志
lines.py: xián xián yǎn yì shēng shēng sī, sì sù píng shēng bù dé zhì
lines.lit: Every string muffled and held down, every sound full of longing; as if telling of a whole life of not achieving one’s hopes.
lines.en: Each string held back, each note heavy with sorrow, as if telling of a life that never went her way.

lines.zh: 低眉信手续续弹，说尽心中无限事。
lines.rhythm: 低眉/信手/续续弹，说尽/心中/无限事
lines.py: dī méi xìn shǒu xù xù tán, shuō jìn xīn zhōng wú xiàn shì
lines.lit: Lowering her brows, letting her hands go, playing on and on; telling all the endless things in her heart.
lines.en: Eyes lowered, hands moving freely, she played on, saying everything her heart had held.

lines.zh: 轻拢慢捻抹复挑，初为《霓裳》后《六幺》。
lines.rhythm: 轻拢/慢捻/抹复挑，初为/霓裳/后六幺
lines.py: qīng lǒng màn niǎn mò fù tiāo, chū wéi ní cháng hòu liù yāo
lines.lit: Lightly pressing, slowly twisting, stroking down and then flicking up; first playing “Rainbow Skirt”, then “Six Measures”.
lines.en: Pressing lightly, rolling slowly, sweeping down and flicking up, she played “Rainbow Skirt”, then “Six Measures”.
lines.tts: 轻拢慢捻末复挑，初为霓裳后六腰。

lines.zh: 大弦嘈嘈如急雨，小弦切切如私语。
lines.rhythm: 大弦/嘈嘈/如急雨，小弦/切切/如私语
lines.py: dà xián cáo cáo rú jí yǔ, xiǎo xián qiè qiè rú sī yǔ
lines.lit: The big strings, deep and loud, like sudden rain; the small strings, soft and fine, like whispering.
lines.en: The thick strings roared like a sudden downpour; the thin strings murmured like lovers whispering.

lines.zh: 嘈嘈切切错杂弹，大珠小珠落玉盘。
lines.rhythm: 嘈嘈/切切/错杂弹，大珠/小珠/落玉盘
lines.py: cáo cáo qiè qiè cuò zá tán, dà zhū xiǎo zhū luò yù pán
lines.lit: Loud and soft, mixed together, played; big pearls, small pearls fall on a jade plate.
lines.en: Roar and murmur tumbled together, like pearls large and small dropping onto a jade plate.

lines.zh: 间关莺语花底滑，幽咽泉流冰下难。
lines.rhythm: 间关/莺语/花底滑，幽咽/泉流/冰下难
lines.py: jiān guān yīng yǔ huā dǐ huá, yōu yè quán liú bīng xià nán
lines.lit: Liquid and lilting, an oriole’s song gliding under the flowers; choked and sobbing, a spring flowing with difficulty under ice.
lines.en: Now it slipped along like an oriole singing under blossoms, now it sobbed like a spring struggling beneath the ice.
lines.tts: 间关莺语花底滑，幽夜泉流冰下难。

lines.zh: 冰泉冷涩弦凝绝，凝绝不通声暂歇。
lines.rhythm: 冰泉/冷涩/弦凝绝，凝绝/不通/声暂歇
lines.py: bīng quán lěng sè xián níng jué, níng jué bù tōng shēng zàn xiē
lines.lit: The icy spring cold and rough, the strings freeze and break off; frozen, not flowing, the sound stops for a while.
lines.en: The icy spring grew cold and stiff, the strings seemed to freeze; frozen, they could not flow, and the sound fell still.

lines.zh: 别有幽愁暗恨生，此时无声胜有声。
lines.rhythm: 别有/幽愁/暗恨生，此时/无声/胜有声
lines.py: bié yǒu yōu chóu àn hèn shēng, cǐ shí wú shēng shèng yǒu shēng
lines.lit: Another kind of hidden sorrow and secret regret arises; at this moment, no sound is better than sound.
lines.en: A deeper, hidden grief rose up — and in that moment, silence said more than any note.

lines.zh: 银瓶乍破水浆迸，铁骑突出刀枪鸣。
lines.rhythm: 银瓶/乍破/水浆迸，铁骑/突出/刀枪鸣
lines.py: yín píng zhà pò shuǐ jiāng bèng, tiě jì tū chū dāo qiāng míng
lines.lit: A silver jar suddenly breaks, water bursts out; armoured horsemen charge out, swords and spears ring.
lines.en: Then, like a silver jar bursting and water splashing out, like armoured riders charging with clashing blades —
lines.tts: 银瓶乍破水浆迸，铁记突出刀枪鸣。

lines.zh: 曲终收拨当心画，四弦一声如裂帛。
lines.rhythm: 曲终/收拨/当心画，四弦/一声/如裂帛
lines.py: qǔ zhōng shōu bō dāng xīn huà, sì xián yī shēng rú liè bó
lines.lit: The tune ends; drawing back the plectrum, she strokes across the middle; four strings, one sound, like tearing silk.
lines.en: the tune ended. She swept the plectrum across the centre: all four strings cried out at once, like silk torn apart.

lines.zh: 东船西舫悄无言，唯见江心秋月白。
lines.rhythm: 东船/西舫/悄无言，唯见/江心/秋月白
lines.py: dōng chuán xī fǎng qiǎo wú yán, wéi jiàn jiāng xīn qiū yuè bái
lines.lit: East boats, west boats, quiet, no words; only seeing in the river’s heart the autumn moon, white.
lines.en: On every boat around, no one said a word; there was only the white autumn moon in the middle of the river.

lines.zh: 沉吟放拨插弦中，整顿衣裳起敛容。
lines.rhythm: 沉吟/放拨/插弦中，整顿/衣裳/起敛容
lines.py: chén yín fàng bō chā xián zhōng, zhěng dùn yī cháng qǐ liǎn róng
lines.lit: Hesitating, she puts the plectrum down, slipping it among the strings; straightening her clothes, she rises, composing her face.
lines.en: She paused, tucked the plectrum between the strings, smoothed her dress, stood, and composed herself.

lines.zh: 自言本是京城女，家在虾蟆陵下住。
lines.rhythm: 自言/本是/京城女，家在/虾蟆/陵下住
lines.py: zì yán běn shì jīng chéng nǚ, jiā zài há má líng xià zhù
lines.lit: She says of herself she was originally a girl of the capital; her home was below Toad Mound.
lines.en: “I was a girl of the capital,” she said, “and lived down by Toad Hill.
lines.tts: 自言本是京城女，家在蛤蟆陵下住。

lines.zh: 十三学得琵琶成，名属教坊第一部。
lines.rhythm: 十三/学得/琵琶成，名属/教坊/第一部
lines.py: shí sān xué dé pí pá chéng, míng shǔ jiào fāng dì yī bù
lines.lit: At thirteen she had learned the pipa fully; her name belonged to the first section of the Music Academy.
lines.en: By thirteen I had mastered the pipa, and was listed in the first rank of the court music school.

lines.zh: 曲罢曾教善才服，妆成每被秋娘妒。
lines.rhythm: 曲罢/曾教/善才服，妆成/每被/秋娘妒
lines.py: qǔ bà céng jiāo shàn cái fú, zhuāng chéng měi bèi qiū niáng dù
lines.lit: When a tune was done, she once made the masters admire her; when her make-up was done, she was always envied by the famous beauties.
lines.en: When I finished playing, even the old masters bowed to me; when I was dressed, the leading beauties were jealous.
lines.tts: 曲罢曾交善才服，妆成每被秋娘妒。

lines.zh: 五陵年少争缠头，一曲红绡不知数。
lines.rhythm: 五陵/年少/争缠头，一曲/红绡/不知数
lines.py: wǔ líng nián shào zhēng chán tóu, yī qǔ hóng xiāo bù zhī shù
lines.lit: Young men of the Five Mounds competed to give head-wrapping gifts; for one tune, red silk beyond counting.
lines.en: Rich young men fought to shower me with gifts — for a single song, more red silk than anyone could count.

lines.zh: 钿头银篦击节碎，血色罗裙翻酒污。
lines.rhythm: 钿头/银篦/击节碎，血色/罗裙/翻酒污
lines.py: diàn tóu yín bì jī jié suì, xuè sè luó qún fān jiǔ wū
lines.lit: Inlaid silver combs, beating time, broke; blood-red silk skirts were stained by spilled wine.
lines.en: I broke jewelled combs beating time to the music, and stained blood-red skirts with spilled wine.

lines.zh: 今年欢笑复明年，秋月春风等闲度。
lines.rhythm: 今年/欢笑/复明年，秋月/春风/等闲度
lines.py: jīn nián huān xiào fù míng nián, qiū yuè chūn fēng děng xián dù
lines.lit: This year laughing, and again next year; autumn moons and spring breezes passed carelessly.
lines.en: One year of laughter followed another; autumn moons and spring winds slipped by without a thought.

lines.zh: 弟走从军阿姨死，暮去朝来颜色故。
lines.rhythm: 弟走/从军/阿姨死，暮去/朝来/颜色故
lines.py: dì zǒu cóng jūn ā yí sǐ, mù qù zhāo lái yán sè gù
lines.lit: My brother left to join the army, my auntie died; evenings go, mornings come, my looks grow old.
lines.en: Then my brother went off to the army, the woman who raised me died, and day by day my beauty faded.
lines.tts: 弟走从军阿姨死，暮去招来颜色故。

lines.zh: 门前冷落鞍马稀，老大嫁作商人妇。
lines.rhythm: 门前/冷落/鞍马稀，老大/嫁作/商人妇
lines.py: mén qián lěng luò ān mǎ xī, lǎo dà jià zuò shāng rén fù
lines.lit: Before the gate, deserted, saddled horses few; old, I married and became a merchant’s wife.
lines.en: My gate grew quiet, few horses stopped there, and no longer young, I married a merchant.

lines.zh: 商人重利轻别离，前月浮梁买茶去。
lines.rhythm: 商人/重利/轻别离，前月/浮梁/买茶去
lines.py: shāng rén zhòng lì qīng bié lí, qián yuè fú liáng mǎi chá qù
lines.lit: A merchant values profit and takes parting lightly; last month he went to Fuliang to buy tea.
lines.en: A merchant cares for profit more than for parting — last month he left for Fuliang to buy tea.

lines.zh: 去来江口守空船，绕船月明江水寒。
lines.rhythm: 去来/江口/守空船，绕船/月明/江水寒
lines.py: qù lái jiāng kǒu shǒu kōng chuán, rào chuán yuè míng jiāng shuǐ hán
lines.lit: Since he left, at the river mouth I guard an empty boat; around the boat, bright moon, cold river water.
lines.en: Since then I keep an empty boat at the river mouth, with only bright moonlight and cold water all around.

lines.zh: 夜深忽梦少年事，梦啼妆泪红阑干。
lines.rhythm: 夜深/忽梦/少年事，梦啼/妆泪/红阑干
lines.py: yè shēn hū mèng shào nián shì, mèng tí zhuāng lèi hóng lán gān
lines.lit: Deep in the night I suddenly dream of my youth; crying in the dream, tears with make-up run red in streaks.
lines.en: Late at night I dream of when I was young, and weep in my sleep till my rouge runs down in red streaks.”

lines.zh: 我闻琵琶已叹息，又闻此语重唧唧。
lines.rhythm: 我闻/琵琶/已叹息，又闻/此语/重唧唧
lines.py: wǒ wén pí pá yǐ tàn xī, yòu wén cǐ yǔ chóng jī jī
lines.lit: I heard the pipa and already sighed; again hearing these words, I sigh once more.
lines.en: Her music had already made me sigh; hearing her story, I sighed again.
lines.tts: 我闻琵琶已叹息，又闻此语虫唧唧。

lines.zh: 同是天涯沦落人，相逢何必曾相识！
lines.rhythm: 同是/天涯/沦落人，相逢/何必/曾相识
lines.py: tóng shì tiān yá lún luò rén, xiāng féng hé bì céng xiāng shí
lines.lit: Both are people fallen and adrift at the edge of the sky; meeting, why must we have known each other before!
lines.en: We are both cast adrift at the far end of the world — to meet like this, who needs to have met before?

lines.zh: 我从去年辞帝京，谪居卧病浔阳城。
lines.rhythm: 我从/去年/辞帝京，谪居/卧病/浔阳城
lines.py: wǒ cóng qù nián cí dì jīng, zhé jū wò bìng xún yáng chéng
lines.lit: Since last year I left the imperial capital; living in demotion, lying ill in Xunyang city.
lines.en: Last year I was sent away from the capital, and now I live in exile, often ill, in Xunyang.

lines.zh: 浔阳地僻无音乐，终岁不闻丝竹声。
lines.rhythm: 浔阳/地僻/无音乐，终岁/不闻/丝竹声
lines.py: xún yáng dì pì wú yīn yuè, zhōng suì bù wén sī zhú shēng
lines.lit: Xunyang is remote, no music; all year I don’t hear the sound of strings and flutes.
lines.en: Xunyang is far from everything: there is no music here, and all year long I hear no strings or flutes.

lines.zh: 住近湓江地低湿，黄芦苦竹绕宅生。
lines.rhythm: 住近/湓江/地低湿，黄芦/苦竹/绕宅生
lines.py: zhù jìn pén jiāng dì dī shī, huáng lú kǔ zhú rào zhái shēng
lines.lit: I live near the Pen River, the land low and damp; yellow reeds and bitter bamboo grow around the house.
lines.en: My house stands near the Pen River on low, damp ground, ringed by yellow reeds and bitter bamboo.

lines.zh: 其间旦暮闻何物？杜鹃啼血猿哀鸣。
lines.rhythm: 其间/旦暮/闻何物，杜鹃/啼血/猿哀鸣
lines.py: qí jiān dàn mù wén hé wù, dù juān tí xuè yuán āi míng
lines.lit: There, morning and evening, what do I hear? The cuckoo crying blood, the monkeys’ sad cries.
lines.en: And what do I hear there, morning and night? Cuckoos crying till they bleed, and the mournful call of gibbons.

lines.zh: 春江花朝秋月夜，往往取酒还独倾。
lines.rhythm: 春江/花朝/秋月夜，往往/取酒/还独倾
lines.py: chūn jiāng huā zhāo qiū yuè yè, wǎng wǎng qǔ jiǔ huán dú qīng
lines.lit: Spring river, flower mornings, autumn moon nights; often I take wine and again drink it alone.
lines.en: On spring mornings full of flowers, on autumn nights under the moon, I often take out wine and drink it alone.
lines.tts: 春江花招秋月夜，往往取酒环独倾。

lines.zh: 岂无山歌与村笛？呕哑嘲哳难为听。
lines.rhythm: 岂无/山歌/与村笛，呕哑/嘲哳/难为听
lines.py: qǐ wú shān gē yǔ cūn dí, ōu yā zhāo zhā nán wéi tīng
lines.lit: Is it that there are no mountain songs or village flutes? Harsh and jarring, hard to listen to.
lines.en: Of course there are hill songs and village pipes — but they screech and rasp, and are hard to bear.
lines.tts: 岂无山歌与村笛？欧压招扎难为听。

lines.zh: 今夜闻君琵琶语，如听仙乐耳暂明。
lines.rhythm: 今夜/闻君/琵琶语，如听/仙乐/耳暂明
lines.py: jīn yè wén jūn pí pá yǔ, rú tīng xiān yuè ěr zàn míng
lines.lit: Tonight hearing your pipa speak, as if hearing immortal music, my ears for a moment become clear.
lines.en: Tonight, hearing your pipa speak, it was like music from heaven — for a moment my ears came alive.

lines.zh: 莫辞更坐弹一曲，为君翻作琵琶行。
lines.rhythm: 莫辞/更坐/弹一曲，为君/翻作/琵琶行
lines.py: mò cí gèng zuò tán yī qǔ, wèi jūn fān zuò pí pá xíng
lines.lit: Don’t refuse, sit again and play one more tune; for you I will turn it into a “Song of the Pipa”.
lines.en: Please don’t refuse — sit down and play once more, and I will write it into a song of the pipa for you.

lines.zh: 感我此言良久立，却坐促弦弦转急。
lines.rhythm: 感我/此言/良久立，却坐/促弦/弦转急
lines.py: gǎn wǒ cǐ yán liáng jiǔ lì, què zuò cù xián xián zhuǎn jí
lines.lit: Moved by my words, she stands a long while; then sits back, tightens the strings, and the strings turn urgent.
lines.en: Moved by what I said, she stood for a long time; then she sat down, tightened the strings, and played faster.

lines.zh: 凄凄不似向前声，满座重闻皆掩泣。
lines.rhythm: 凄凄/不似/向前声，满座/重闻/皆掩泣
lines.py: qī qī bù sì xiàng qián shēng, mǎn zuò chóng wén jiē yǎn qì
lines.lit: Sad and chill, not like the earlier sound; the whole company, hearing again, all cover their faces and weep.
lines.en: It was sadder than anything she had played before, and everyone listening covered their faces and wept.
lines.tts: 凄凄不似向前声，满座虫闻皆掩泣。

lines.zh: 座中泣下谁最多？江州司马青衫湿。
lines.rhythm: 座中/泣下/谁最多，江州/司马/青衫湿
lines.py: zuò zhōng qì xià shuí zuì duō, jiāng zhōu sī mǎ qīng shān shī
lines.lit: Among those seated, whose tears fell most? The Jiangzhou deputy’s blue robe is wet.
lines.en: And who wept most of all? The exiled officer of Jiangzhou — his blue robe soaked with tears.

words.en: pipa, a four-stringed plucked lute
words.note: 今天仍是常见的民族乐器。

words.en: song; ballad (a poem form)
words.note: 古诗的一种体裁，如“琵琶行”“兵车行”；和今天“行走”“可以”的“行”不同。

words.en: rustling; the sound of wind in leaves
words.note: 现代汉语“瑟瑟发抖”指冷得发抖。

words.en: pipes and strings — music
words.note: 管是吹的乐器，弦是弹拉的乐器；今天说“管弦乐”。

words.en: called again and again
words.note: 今天仍是成语，常说“千呼万唤始出来”，指等了很久才出现。

words.py: qīng lǒng màn niǎn mò fù tiāo
words.en: four pipa techniques: press, twist, sweep down, flick up
words.note: 拢、捻、抹、挑都是弹琵琶的指法，今天学琵琶还用这些名称。

words.en: names of two famous Tang dance tunes
words.note: 《霓裳羽衣曲》《六幺》，唐代的大曲名。

words.en: deep and loud, like heavy rain
words.note: 今天的“嘈杂”指吵闹，带贬义；这里只是形容声音重。

words.en: soft and fine, like a whisper
words.note: 现代汉语“切切”多是“千万”的意思（切切不可）。

words.py: dà zhū xiǎo zhū luò yù pán
words.en: big and small pearls falling on a jade plate
words.note: 今天常用来形容声音清脆好听。

words.en: low and choked, like sobbing
words.note: “咽”这里读 yè，同“哽咽”；不读 yān（咽喉）。

words.py: cǐ shí wú shēng shèng yǒu shēng
words.en: at this moment silence says more than sound
words.note: 今天仍常被引用，形容沉默比说话更有力量。

words.en: armoured cavalry
words.note: “骑”这里指骑马的人，古读 jì；今天审音统读 qí。

words.en: the imperial music academy
words.note: 唐代管理宫廷音乐、歌舞的机构，今天已不用。

words.en: gifts of silk given to a performer
words.note: 古代送给歌舞艺人的绸缎、财物，今天不用。

words.en: carelessly; lightly
words.note: 古义“随随便便”；今天“非同等闲”还保留这个意思。

words.en: looks; beauty of the face
words.note: 古义指容貌；今天“颜色”指红、黄、蓝等色彩。

words.en: the end of the sky — very far away
words.note: 今天仍常说“天涯海角”。

words.en: fallen on hard times; cast adrift
words.note: 今天也说，如“沦落街头”。

words.en: assistant prefect (Bai Juyi’s demoted post)
words.note: 唐代州里的副职官，这里是诗人自称；今天作复姓。

imagery.name: 琵琶
imagery.zh: 琵琶是全诗的线索：琵琶声引出相遇，琵琶曲道出女子的身世，最后又让诗人泪湿青衫。
imagery.en: The pipa ties the whole poem together: its sound brings the meeting, its music tells the woman’s life, and in the end it makes the poet weep.

imagery.name: 月
imagery.zh: “江浸月”“江心秋月白”“绕船月明”：三次写江上的冷月，一次比一次孤寂，衬出离别和独守空船的凄凉。
imagery.en: The cold moon on the river appears three times — at the parting, after the music, and around her empty boat — each time lonelier than the last.

imagery.name: 枫
imagery.zh: 开头的枫叶和荻花点明深秋，也给全诗定下萧瑟的调子。
imagery.en: The maple leaves and reed flowers in the first line set the scene in late autumn and give the whole poem its bleak mood.

imagery.name: 杜鹃
imagery.zh: 诗人在江州朝夕听到杜鹃啼血、猿猴哀鸣，用凄厉的叫声写被贬的苦闷。
imagery.en: Morning and night in exile the poet hears cuckoos “crying blood” and gibbons wailing — sounds that voice his own misery.
